title: Best Black Friday / Cyber Monday Cycling Deals
content:
Black Friday. Ugh. We get it. It’s that time of year when your inbox is bombarded with “deals” that are actually equal to the retail price of the same item just a few months ago, before inflation and price adjustments raised prices to crazy levels. But we also know that everything, including cycling products, is more expensive than ever. And if taking advantage of these sales can save you a few dollars on something you were going to buy anyway, we’re happy to steer you in the right direction.

The black hole of Black Friday deals is bigger than ever, it seems – some deals end sooner than others, and there’s a LOT on offer this year.

As always, everything’s listed alphabetically by category. And as always, shopping through these links helps support Bikerumor directly. In the age of AI taking all the credit (and our traffic), we appreciate you spending your bike bucks with through us.

So Step #1: make sure to spend plenty of time with your family and friends. Step #2: make sure to go for a ride – indoors, outdoors, doesn’t matter. Just get the legs spinning. Step #3: If you have some downtime over the holidays and you’re looking for cycling Black Friday or Cyber Monday deals, check out this list first.

Thank you, Happy Thanksgiving, and good hunting, friends!

Black Friday Deals you can get now (and some starting a bit later):

Bikes

  • Ari – Up to 36% off select gravel, MTB & eBikes
  • Aventon – Up to $200 off plus free accessories while supplies last
  • Canyon – Up to 40% off road, gravel, mountain & commuter bikes, plus gear
  • Huffy – Various discounts on bikes and kids’ e-mobility toys (Nov 23 – Dec 15)
  • Ibis – Up to $1800 off complete bikes (US only, order through local dealer), plus gear deals
  • Moots – Factory sale has new bikes added (ongoing)
  • Obed – 15% to 20% off road & gravel bikes, plus daily deals (Nov 16 – Dec 6)
  • Otso – Waheela R allroad frameset 30% off, complete bikes 15% off
  • Priority Cycles – Up to $1500 off bikes
  • Ridley – Up to 50% off select bikes
  • Ritchey – Up to 25% off select frames and forks
  • Segway – Up to $1300 off e-bikes, plus deals on battery packs
  • Specialized – Discounts up to $3,100 on road, gravel, MTB, e-bikes & more
  • Transition – Select builds on all MTBs & eMTBs on sale
  • Velotric – Up to $600 off bikes, plus discounted & free accessories (Nov 2 – Dec 6)

Components

  • Boyd Wheels – 20% off all road, gravel & MTB wheels w/code BFCM26
  • Cane Creek – Various deals start Nov 25
  • Crank Brothers – Up to 50% off sitewide, use code BFCM26 even on sale items for more
  • CyclingCeramic – 15% off everything, or 50% off a cage or pulley wheels with any bottom bracket
  • Duke Wheels – Up to 70% off (Int’l site only; don’t select “US site”)
  • HED Wheels – Up to 25% off select wheels
  • Hunt Wheels – 30% to 40% off road, gravel & MTB wheels
  • Industry Nine – Free tires & sealant w/ wheel purchase
  • Kogel – Free ceramic BB w/ Speed Kolossos OSPW derailleur upgrade
  • Rotor – Up to 50% off select cranksets, chainrings & more (thru Nov 30)
  • Scope – 30% off S4 road & S4.A all-road wheels
  • Sinter – 50% off Black brake pads globally, 20% off sitewide in USA
  • Stan’s – 40% off prior season wheels; 20% or more off current stock

Helmets & Sunglasses

  • Limar – Big discounts on helmets, kits & more
  • POC – Up to 45% off helmets, protection & more
  • Roka – up to 40% off sunglasses (thru Dec 1)
  • Rudy Project – Up to 30% off helmets, shades & more; free shipping in Lower 48
  • Tifosi – 25% off sitewide, including prescription sunglasses, w/code BF26

Apparel & Shoes

  • 7Mesh – Up to 50% off men’s & women’s bike and technical apparel
  • Arcade Belts – $5 donated to Big City Mountaineers for every belt sold (Nov 23-30)
  • Club Ride – Up to 60% off men’s & women’s casual ride gear
  • EKOI – Up to 60% off clothing, helmets & glasses; Plus, 10% Extra off with code: SPRINT
  • Handup – Almost everything is on sale, site-wide, no code needed.
  • Mission Workshop – Backpacks, Duffles, Totes & Apparel 20% off sitewide (Nov 21-30)
  • Race Face – Up to 70% off protection and apparel
  • Showers Pass – 25% to 40% off waterproof pants, jackets & more (Nov 26-30)
  • Terry – Women’s cycling shorts up to 50% off
  • Velocio – up to 30% off jerseys, 25% off select bibs and jackets, and 20% off select MTB styles (Nov 17-30)
  • VeloToze – up to 50% off all gear; plus buy 2+ items and get an extra 20% off

Cycling Gear

  • Abbey Bike Tools – The One Sale runs from 11/16-11/30 with 15% off nearly the entire catalog, up to 20% off kits, & more
  • Better Bolts – 20% off sitewide w/code BLACKFRIDAY2026
  • Chamois Butt’r – 20% off all 8oz tubes online, on Amazon, and on TheFeed.com
  • EVOC – Up to 20% off bike bags; 60% to 69% off hydration packs, protection & more
  • Feedback Sports – Tools, scales, stands & more up to 30% off
  • Freedom Coast – 20% sitewide, including AXS Pod relocates w/code BLACKFRIDAY2026
  • Hollywood Racks – Free lock & accessory bundle w/ rack purchase (thru Dec 2)
  • Honey Stinger – 25% sitewide (30% with SMS signup) + free waffle wallet while they last
  • Lezyne – Up to 25% off most products (thru Dec 1)
  • Litelok – Up to $55 off locks, 20% off select accessories (thru Nov 30)
  • Muc-Off – 25% off everything, including bike & moto stuff
  • Saris – Up to 30% off sitewide, deals change after Nov 25
  • Scicon – Bike travel bags up to 55% off plus free shipping w/code BLACKFRIDAY10
  • Silca – 20% off almost everything, 75% off some things
  • SNEK Cycling – Buy any item, get 50% off another w/code BOGO50
  • USWE – Up to 60% off packs, clothing, accessories & more
  • Yakima – 20% off sitewide plus free shipping

Cycling Tech & Other Rad Stuff

  • BC Bike Race – $250 off w/code TB250 (thru Nov 30), or bonus value on gift cards (thru Dec 15)
  • CORE 2 – Measure core body temp for less w/ 20% off Core 2 Thermal Sensor
  • Coros – 25% off HR monitor with any watch or cycling computer
  • Foothills – Discounts on their Trainer Tray, bottle cage bottle opener & more!
  • GoPro – Up to $200 off action cameras, plus accessory deals
  • HOVERAir – Drones and combo kits up to 20% off online & on Amazon (Nov 19-30)
  • Knog – Bike lights, bells, alarms, headlamps & more up to 40% off sitewide (Nov 16 – Dec 1)
  • Nix – Hydration biosensor starter kit 35% off (thru Nov 30)
  • Quad Lock – 30% off everything, plus bonus cash based on order size
  • Rouvy – Deals on various smart trainers
  • Stages – Powermeter-equipped crank arms from just $150; free shipping on Smart Bike
  • Wahoo Fitness – 20% off cycling computers, $150 to $300 off smart trainers (Nov 20 or 27-30)
  • Zwift – Zwift bike and Wahoo trainers on sale, w/ bonus HSA/FSA savings

Online Retailer Black Friday / Cyber Monday Deal Pages

  • Backcountry – Up to 70% off cycling, outdoor, and other gear
  • Competitive Cyclist – Up to 50% off all categories, new additions added all the time
  • EVO – Up to 55% off
  • JensonUSA – Big savings on all the things, as usual
  • TheFeed – Massive deals on many top nutrition brands, incl. 25% off Skratch Labs
author: Travis Reill
